readings.source_reading: .. ← (two dots and a left-pointing arrow in the inner margin)
readings.evidence: In the native tile the arrow is at about canvas x 410-630, y 2360-2395. It sits on the ruled line between c. 384(7) at about y 2325 and b. 93(3)a at about y 2450. Its head points toward the gutter, where the fol. 22b addition 'b. 99 (9) ... n.d. : ⟦..⟧ 7:6/7: Beng' sits at the same height. Its position between two entries is compatible with an insertion point for a separate holding. It is not clearly linked to b. 93(3)a, and its function is not stated.

The line is indented and struck through. It sits directly below the ': R.L. Mitra, II, 967.' line of b. 93(3)a and above the c. 383(1) entry. The c. 383(1) entry has its own 'Begins (main):-' incipit, which slightly favours b. 93(3)a. However, the source contains no explicit attachment.
